from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,datetime,tarfile
root=Path('/workspace/experiments/minicpm-s2/framework')
ids=['20261022T070004Z-cpu-combination-baseline-decode4k','20261022T070452Z-cpu-combination-combined-decode4k']
keys=['snapshot_sha256','schema_sha256','logical_content_sha256','table_count','row_count']
dbs=[]
for name in ids:
 c=root/(name+'-control')
 for phase in ['before','after']:
  d=json.loads((c/('db-'+phase)/'manifest.json').read_text())
  dbs.append({k:d[k] for k in keys})
assert all(d==dbs[0] for d in dbs)
print(json.dumps({'four_db_endpoints_equal':True,'db':dbs[0]}))
for name in ids:
 r=root/name;c=root/(name+'-control')
 assert (r/'exit-code').read_text().strip()=='0'
 assert (r/'finished-at.txt').exists()
 files={}
 for folder in [r,c]:
  for p in sorted(folder.rglob('*')):
   if p.is_symlink():raise RuntimeError('unexpected alias '+str(p))
   if p.is_file():files[p.relative_to(root).as_posix()]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 seal={'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'files_sha256':files,'run_id':name,'status':'complete','four_db_endpoints_equal':True}
 with (c/'seal.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(seal,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
 archive=root/(name+'.tgz')
 assert not archive.exists()
 with tarfile.open(archive,'x:gz') as f:
  f.add(r,arcname=r.name);f.add(c,arcname=c.name)
 print(json.dumps({'path':str(archive),'bytes':archive.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'seal_files':len(files)}))

from pathlib import Path,PurePosixPath
import json,hashlib,tarfile
root=Path.cwd()/'experiments/framework'
items=json.loads(r'''[{"path":"/workspace/experiments/minicpm-s2/framework/20261022T070004Z-cpu-combination-baseline-decode4k.tgz","bytes":2477555,"sha256":"0512d379eca1613e716a0c1314c55b3aa6ccdaf07d670034f31f2ce1f85e5150","seal_files":450},{"path":"/workspace/experiments/minicpm-s2/framework/20261022T070452Z-cpu-combination-combined-decode4k.tgz","bytes":2480387,"sha256":"508f74efc10997b39b7d3166b45bddbb5cce85908d47d0fe807724d8e3aeb764","seal_files":451}]''')
for d in items:
 p=root/Path(d['path']).name
 assert p.stat().st_size==d['bytes']
 assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==d['sha256']
 name=p.name[:-4]
 assert not (root/name).exists() and not (root/(name+'-control')).exists()
 with tarfile.open(p) as f:
  members=f.getmembers()
  for member in members:
   parts=PurePosixPath(member.name).parts
   assert parts and parts[0] in (name,name+'-control') and '..' not in parts
   assert not PurePosixPath(member.name).is_absolute()
   assert member.isfile() or member.isdir(),member.name
  f.extractall(root,filter='data')
 seal=json.loads((root/(name+'-control')/'seal.json').read_text())
 assert len(seal['files_sha256'])==d['seal_files']
 for name,expected in seal['files_sha256'].items():
  assert hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected,name
 print(json.dumps({'archive':p.name,'bytes':d['bytes'],'sha256':d['sha256'],'seal_files_verified':d['seal_files'],'scp_exit_code':0}))
note_zh: 等待SCP真实exit0后核归档长度/SHA、检查tar成员安全路径并解包，再核450/451项seal。最初live-vs-backup物理SHA比较失败未启动GPU；原说明与六字节差记录在baseline-control/combined-prelaunch-db-check.json。两轮原件及SQLite快照均在tgz内保留。
